title: There’s No Such Thing as a Good Christian (Here’s Why)

top_liked.author: @realvlad40
top_liked.text: Never understood why God needs a book written by humans to communicate with us or why he requires worship and flattery so much. The entire concept seems like psychological training for instilling obedience in the masses.

top_liked.author: @seanmadson8524
top_liked.text:
"To God the glory be" sums it up. Christianity claims that humans are completely incapable of doing anything praiseworthy, all praise belongs to God. Pride in anything you accomplish is sinful. 

Of course, none of your mistakes or failures are attributed to God, that's just you…

top_liked.author: @theleelaverse
top_liked.text: I love the idea of needing people not “salvation”. I have a song lyric that says “we don’t need a savior, we just need to lift each other up”. I am happy we’re on the same page.

top_liked.author: @ThisIsJustAUsername
top_liked.text: Wow.  This one hit hard.  I had never thought about the emotional dependence that Christianity creates through guilt.

top_liked.author: @calebdrew5684
top_liked.text: 7:00 "You're not being taught how to live well, you're being taught how to relapse in ways that keep you emotionally hooked."  That's some wisdom that blew my mind man, thanks!

top_liked.author: @stanleystrong9591
top_liked.text: You're taught you can't be good. What that thought does to your self esteem is horrible. Thank you for making this so clear. You are really helping me with my deconversion. Much love my brother.

top_liked.author: @roc5291
top_liked.text: My biggest problem with this religion is that, it’s an apocalyptic religion. It all hinges on the idea that their overlord is going to come and destroy the entire essence of life as we know it. The only thing worse than that is that, the overwhelming majority of people who will…

top_liked.author: @user-os5zj2rv7x
top_liked.text: If "God" knows good AND evil,  like Genesis says, it cannot be a good God period. If there's duality and one is not good, it cannot be good. A tomato that's half bad is NOT a good tomato.

top_liked.text:

Gee, what a statement and it is so true...
